title: Cursor vs OpenAI Codex CLI: Which AI Coding Tool Wins in 2026?
summary: Cursor is the AI-powered IDE. Codex CLI is OpenAI's cloud agent. This honest breakdown tells you exactly which to use — and when Blink makes both irrelevant.
body_markdown: Cursor is optimized for in-context editing of large codebases — it indexes your entire repo and keeps it available during chats. Codex CLI handles large-scale refactors well via cloud tasks that can run for extended periods. For a large codebase that needs a new feature with proper backend and database support,[Blink](https://blink.new/) handles the infrastructure layer so the agent can focus on business logic rather than plumbing.
